title: Voice Process Associate - Night Shift
description:
Voice Process Associate for an international night-shift process.

Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound customer calls for a US-based client.
- Maintain call quality scores and daily reporting.

Requirements:
- Must have neutral English accent; Bengali and Hindi not required.
- Required: 1-2 years of experience in an international voice process.
- Rotational night shift is mandatory.

Candidates must arrange their own transport. Security deposit of Rs 5000 refundable after probation.
